status.queue: {count, plural, =0 {All scans sent} one {# scan waiting to send} other {# scans waiting to send}}

download.title: Downloading the guest list
download.body: Keep the phone connected until it finishes. After that, scanning works without a connection.
download.failedOffline: Can't download the guest list. Check the connection and try again.
download.failedNotAssigned: This device isn't assigned to this event. Ask an organizer to check its enrolment.
download.failedScope: The guest list failed its security check. Try again, or ask an organizer to enrol this device again.

expired.title: Guest list removed
expired.body: The event ended more than a day ago, so the guest list was deleted from this phone.

camera.askBody: Yayatoh Staff uses the camera to read ticket QR codes at the door.
camera.deniedBody: Turn on the camera for Yayatoh Staff in Settings to scan QR codes. You can still type a ticket code.
camera.unavailable: No camera was found on this device.
camera.preview: Camera view. Point it at a ticket QR code.

manual.title: Ticket code
manual.label: Ticket code
manual.hint: Type the code printed under the QR code, then check it.

provisional.title: Admit and flag
provisional.hint: Not on the guest list yet. Let them in; a supervisor will check.

duplicate.title: Already scanned
duplicate.hint: This ticket was already scanned in today.

duplicate_offline.title: Duplicate found
duplicate_offline.hint: Another door admitted this ticket first.

superseded.title: Old ticket
superseded.hint: This code was replaced. Ask for the latest ticket.

void.title: Cancelled ticket
void.hint: This ticket was refunded or cancelled. Do not admit.

invalid.title: Not recognised
invalid.hint: This is not a valid ticket for this event.

wrong_event.title: Wrong event
wrong_event.hint: This ticket is for a different event.

wrong_checkpoint.title: Wrong entrance
wrong_checkpoint.hint: This device is not set up to scan at this entrance.

balance_due.title: Balance due
balance_due.hint: Send them to the desk to pay the balance.

flagged.title: {count, plural, one {# scan needs a second look} other {# scans need a second look}}
flagged.duplicate: Another door admitted this ticket too. Check that the person is not entering twice.
flagged.rejected: This scan could not be sent and was dropped.
flagged.other: The server judged this scan differently. A supervisor will review it.

home.title: Yayatoh Staff
home.tagline: Door tools for event day are coming soon.

enrol.title: Enrol this device
enrol.intro: Ask the event organizer to show the enrolment QR code from the console, then scan it here. This device needs no personal account.

notices.revoked: An organizer removed this device from the event. Scan a new enrolment code to use it again.
notices.wiped: An organizer wiped this device. Its token and data were erased. Scan a new enrolment code to use it again.

enrol.linkPlaceholder: Paste the link from the console

errors.invalid_link: That is not an enrolment link. Use the QR code or link from the event's devices page.
errors.rejected: This enrolment code is no longer valid. Ask the organizer for a new one.
errors.wrong_event: This code is not for an event this device can work. Ask the organizer for a new one.
errors.unavailable: We could not reach Yayatoh. Check the connection and try again.

replace.title: Replace this device's enrolment?
replace.body: This device is enrolled for {event}. Enrolling again erases its token and everything it saved for that event.

scanner.title: Scan the enrolment code
scanner.hint: Point the camera at the QR code on the organizer's screen.
scanner.preview: Camera view for scanning the enrolment QR code
scanner.invalid: That QR code is not an enrolment code. Scan the one from the event's devices page.

permission.title: Camera access is off
permission.body: Yayatoh Staff needs the camera to read the enrolment QR code. It is used for nothing else.
permission.settingsHint: Camera access was turned off. Open the settings, allow the camera for Yayatoh Staff, then come back.

select.title: Where is this device scanning?
select.unavailable: We could not load this event's entrances. You can still scan at the whole event, or try again.
select.prompt: Choose the entrance this device scans at. An organizer can move it later.
select.refused: That entrance is not available for this device. Choose another one.
select.removeBody: This erases the enrolment token and everything this device saved for the event. You will need a new enrolment code to use it again.

organizer.about: Event organizer? See the event day live: check-ins, throughput, scan issues and devices.
organizer.title: Organizer sign-in
organizer.intro: Use your Yayatoh account. Two-step verification is required.
organizer.codeIntro: Enter the code from your authenticator app, or one of your backup codes.
organizer.twoFactorRequired: Organizer sign-in needs two-step verification. Turn it on in the web console, then sign in here again.

exhibitor.about: Exhibitor? Capture leads at your booth with the invitation you were emailed.
exhibitor.title: Exhibitor sign-in
exhibitor.intro: Open the invitation email and paste its link here. We will email a six-digit code to the invited address.
exhibitor.invitePlaceholder: Paste the link from your invitation email
exhibitor.codeIntro: We emailed a six-digit code to the address you were invited with. It works for 10 minutes.

errors.inviteInvalid: That is not an invitation link. Copy the link from your invitation email.
errors.invalidInvite: This invitation cannot be used. It may have expired or been replaced: ask the organizer to send it again.
errors.codeInvalid: Enter the six digits from the email.
errors.codeRejected: That code can no longer be used. Ask for a new one.
errors.wrongCode: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
errors.wrongCodeAttempts: That code is not right. {count, plural, one {# try left.} other {# tries left.}}
